Zip upload is a demo-only install method. A real merchant install would be a CMS app-store install, which does not exist yet.
No scoped agent token in v0.1.

steps.description: Trigger starts the Coordinating Agent, once or on catalog change. A trigger is not approval.
steps.implemented_note: trigger.py built. coordinator.py itself has no cron or webhook.

steps.description: Plugin Agent defines what the Enrichment Agent must provide and how, before Enrichment runs: diff schema, allowlist, blocked fields, source labels, modelled gate, old-value rule, and approval fingerprint requirement.
steps.implemented_note: Contract is defined in enrichment-agent-definition.md and .json in this folder. Plugin code enforces allowlist, blocked fields, modelled gate, and old-value rule on receipt.

steps.description: Coordinator spawns Audit. Audit reads the live public store, scores readiness, writes gaps.json. Audit tracks gaps only, it does not fill gaps.
Coordinator spawns Enrichment. Enrichment proposes structured fields only from source prose, from gaps.json, writes enrichment_diff.json proposed only, stops at merchant approval, does not publish.

Coordinator spawns Accuracy. Accuracy checks every proposed value against the product's own source prose, writes accuracy_scorecard.json, target 85 percent. Below target, the coordinator stops and Augment must not run. Accuracy never publishes and never changes the live store.

Intended: coordinator spawns Merchant Approval. Approval prepares a packet, groups rows by accuracy, presents no row under 50 percent, records only the merchant's own decision, bound by diff fingerprint. The coordinator owns enrichment correctness, not approval decisions.
steps.implemented_note: Approval agent built standalone in approval/, with approval_record.json awaiting_merchant_decision, published false, approved_count 0. It is not yet spawned by coordinator.py, and workers.json lists it as defined_not_built_today with runner null.

steps.description: Merchant approves or rejects each proposed row, or approves all explicitly. A pending, missing, extra, or held row makes the decision invalid, and nothing may be published. A fingerprint mismatch makes the decision invalid.
steps.implemented_note: Decision file format ovo-merchant-decision 1.0 is defined in approval/AGENT.md. No merchant decision has been recorded yet for the current diff.

steps.description: Coordinator checks the approval record fingerprint against the live diff before any publish. No record, invalid record, or fingerprint mismatch stops the run, fail-closed.
steps.implemented_note: Fingerprint check is defined in approval/AGENT.md. It is not implemented in plugin v0.1, which trusts an admin POST instead.

steps.description: Approved batch is pushed to the plugin at POST /ovo/v1/diff. The plugin does not pull enrichment.
steps.auth_v0_1: WordPress user with manage_options. No scoped agent token, no signed batch.

steps.description: Validate each change: allowlist only, blocked price, stock, SKU, GTIN, tax, shipping, weight, dimensions, modelled only as additional_property, old value must match live store, variation attributes must not be written.
steps.on_failure: That change is listed as rejected with a reason. Other changes are still processed.

steps.description: Keep original first, first-write wins, write safe or medium field or JSON-LD-only value, write audit entry.
Return applied and rejected lists per change.

Server-rendered JSON-LD on single product pages only, plus GET /ovo/v1/manifest, /products, /products/{id}. Nothing on cart, checkout, or account pages. Price and stock are never in the OvO block or REST surface.
Intended: coordinator spawns Re-Audit after Augment to verify the live published score, not just a projected score.
steps.implemented_note: Today Re-Audit runs before Augment in coordinator.py, so live re-audit is 66.7 percent unchanged and the 86.7 percent score is projected only.

steps.description: Shopping agent reads OvO JSON-LD and REST, and reads price and stock from the store's own data.
steps.implemented_note: Read surfaces exist in code. Live reading is untested because the plugin is not installed on Sole Mates yet.

steps.description: Merchant can revert one field or all fields, or run a demo reset with demo mode on and confirm RESET-DEMO. Demo reset keeps the audit log and does not touch orders, carts, or shopper sessions.

coordinator.job: Spawn worker agents of defined scope, in order, fail-closed. Stop at approval gates. Never publish itself. Never buy. The organizer confirms integration, not the coordinator.
coordinator.run_order_note: Today Re-Audit runs before Augment because Augment is skipped, so live is unchanged and the score is projected only. Intended order moves Re-Audit after Augment, so it verifies the live published score.

workers.name: Accuracy
workers.output: accuracy_scorecard.json, ovo-accuracy-scorecard 1.0, 36 of 36, 100.0 percent, meets 85 percent target

workers.name: Merchant Approval
workers.status: built standalone, not yet spawned by coordinator.py
workers.output: approval_packet.json, approval_record.json, ovo-approval-record 1.0, status awaiting_merchant_decision, published false
workers.binding: SHA-256 diff fingerprint. Augment must check the fingerprint against the live diff. A new diff needs a new approval record.

workers.name: Augment
workers.status: defined_not_built_today in coordinator workers.json; Plugin v0.1 built in Stream 3, not yet wired into coordinator.py
workers.output: Published store fields, with revert record

workers.name: Re-Audit
workers.output: agent_run.json, plus projected score in coordinator_run.json

fail_closed_checks: Enrichment output must be proposed only, not published, and proposal_count must match actual rows
Accuracy output must be ovo-accuracy-scorecard 1.0, not published, counts must match Enrichment, percent and verdict must match recomputation
Accuracy below 85 percent stops the run, Augment must not run
Re-Audit live score must be unchanged when nothing was published; if it changed, the coordinator fails with a failure log

modes: --watch, poll live Store API, run once when catalog hash changes, then exit
trigger.safety: A trigger is not an approval. The coordinator still stops at the merchant approval gate, with published false. The trigger never publishes, never buys, and never bypasses a gate. It runs at most once per invocation.
trigger.status: Built as a demo entry point. No cron, webhook, or store-change trigger is built into coordinator.py itself. Automatic triggering by the coordinator is a future requirement, not a completed integration.
trigger.first_sight_rule: A first sight of a catalog records its hash and does not run, so a fresh install does not trigger on its own.

plugin_agent.scope: Prep and manage the Plugin, and manage the integration with the Enrichment Agent.
plugin_agent.defines_for_enrichment_agent: What the Enrichment Agent must provide and how: diff schema, field allowlist, blocked fields, source labels, modelled gate, old-value rule, variation guard, batch id, confidence tiers, and approval fingerprint requirement.
plugin_agent.does_not_define: Enrichment values themselves, which come from source prose only, and merchant approval decisions, which belong to the merchant.
